newsitem.title: FRANCE: Arthuis confident in French 1997 deficit forecast.
newsitem.headline: Arthuis confident in French 1997 deficit forecast.

text.p: French Finance Minister Jean Arthuis told CNN television in an interview on Tuesday that public spending was under control and he was confident France would reach the 1997 target of cutting its public deficit to three percent of GDP.

"Expenses are under control and I am sure France will respect its objective to keep the public deficit at the level of three percent," he said in a prerecorded CNN interview to be broadcast at 1800 GMT.
He said a snap two-round parliamentary election called for May 25 and June 1 would clear the air quickly, to provide an incentive for productive investment to help France achieve its aims.
He also said he was confident in a 1997 forecast of 2.3 percent growth in gross domestic product.
